metadata.description: LLM skills for AI coding agents

plugins.name: github-issues-workflow
plugins.description: Issue-driven development workflow for monorepo projects with GitHub issue templates, PR templates, labels, and Claude Code commands

plugins.name: slack-message
plugins.description: Write Slack messages — plain text with Slack markup, direct and concise, copy-paste ready

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Generate a project-specific clean code review command. Auto-detects tech stacks and produces a /{PREFIX}-code-review command tailored to the repo's modules, architecture, and languages

plugins.name: claude-settings
plugins.description: Configure Claude Code project settings for autonomous, unattended work. Sets up .claude/settings.json and .claude/settings.local.json with permissions, hooks, env vars, and plugins tailored to the project's tech stack

plugins.name: domain-finder
plugins.description: Find creative, available domain names for projects and businesses. Generates candidates across 5 naming strategies (invented words, blends, metaphors, compressed phrases, modified words), checks real availability via whois, and iterates until the user finds one they love

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: Install and customize the Claude Code status line. Self-contained Bash script showing project, auto-compressed path, git branch with dirty-state flags, model with context window and thinking level, context-usage bar with tokens, and session cost. Handles global or project-scoped install, merges settings.json safely, and documents color/segment/threshold customization

plugins.name: vite-chunk-split
plugins.description: Fix Vite single-chunk bundles that cause slow page loads and break MCP Playwright testing. Auto-detects heavy dependencies, converts static page imports to React.lazy, adds Suspense boundaries in layout components, and configures vendor chunk splitting in vite.config.ts. Works for React, Vue, and SvelteKit Vite projects

plugins.name: session-snapshot
plugins.description: Save and restore Claude Code session state across /compact boundaries. Writes a dated handoff markdown to .claude/session-state/ before compact (goal, locked-in decisions, WIP, next-step sequence, open questions, key file anchors) and reads + deletes the most recent file after compact to rehydrate context. Project-local, gitignored, privacy-guarded
